card: Fixes CMake package discovery for CMake-based packages built inside the depends system by setting CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH instead of CMAKE_MODULE_PATH in the configure environment. Previously, CMake ignored the environment variable and bypassed depends-installed packages, finding host system packages instead. The author demonstrates this causes build failures when compiling native_libmultiprocess due to header and generator version mismatches with host-installed CapnProto.
evidence: PR description documents a concrete build failure: "This fixes a build failure in native_libmultiprocess where cmake would find the system (nix) CapnProto 1.2.0 instead of the depends-built CapnProto 1.4.0, resulting in a compile-time version mismatch error: #error 'Version mismatch between generated code and library headers.'"
problem: When building CMake-based depends packages such as native_libmultiprocess, CMake ignores CMAKE_MODULE_PATH from the environment and config-mode find_package() ignores it anyway. If a system version of a dependency like CapnProto is present on the host, CMake picks up the system headers and libraries instead of the ones installed in the depends prefix, causing build failures like version mismatch compilation errors.
summary: Fixes CMake package discovery when building depends packages by exporting CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH instead of CMAKE_MODULE_PATH in depends/funcs.mk. CMake reads CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH from the environment and uses it for config-mode package discovery, ensuring depends packages locate dependencies from the depends prefix rather than the host system.
